title: Strategic Objective
description: Top of the spine (Core Model §02, Figure 1). The intent every process below it ultimately serves. An objective with no operational owner, or with no KPI tracking it, is a data-quality defect the system flags (§01, §12 traceability completeness). LOCKED for Phase 1.

description.description: Human-facing only. Kept out of the agent context package (§08 discipline).

owner_role.description: Single accountable role (not a person, not a team). A null owner is a flagged defect.

horizon.description: Time horizon the objective is set against.

statement.description: The measurable end-state, e.g. 'Median KYC verification under 4h'.

kpi_refs.description: KPIs that measure progress on this objective (objective --targets--> KPI). Empty array is a flagged orphan.

type.description: Hoshin X-matrix axis: breakthrough (3-5yr) or annual objective; foundational = ongoing.

parent_ref.description: The objective one level up (an annual objective rolls up to a breakthrough objective).

applies_to_levels.description: Process-hierarchy levels this objective is deployed at (1-5).
